instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_template.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variants.json in SolidCAM. Generate five independent manufacturing results from C:\Users\User\Desktop\variants.json for C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_template.step. Each variant must use its own pocket size, bottom Z, tool diameter, and program number. Tool rule: each variant in C:\Users\User\Desktop\variants.json supplies pocket size, bottom Z, tool diameter, and program number. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_01.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_02.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_03.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_04.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_05.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
